name: smwgraphics-grassy-seaside
title: Grassy Seaside
description:
This was originally meant to be released at C3, but I felt that I hadn't uploaded anything in a while so making an early upload wouldn't hurt.

It's a grassy seaside, hence the title. It could probably be used in a hub level (with the houses), or just as a general beach tileset. Up to you, really.

Credit isn't required.
